description: Issue a fresh verification token for a customer whose status is pending and send it as the webhook event account.verification_requested to the workspace's webhooks; when the customer's model has account emails on (get_model auth.email.enabled), cmssy also emails the customer itself. The previous token stops working and the new one lasts 24 hours. Refused for a customer who is already verified or is suspended, and after five account requests for the same customer in an hour. `emailDelivery.status` is cmssy's own email: SENT (handed to the email provider), FAILED (not sent - `error` says why, the email log lists it) or OFF (the model leaves emailing to the app). `endpointSubscribed: false` means no enabled webhook endpoint receives the event; with emailDelivery OFF nothing then reaches the customer.
name: resend_customer_verification
title: Resend customer verification
